items.title: Catherine Russell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 26, 2018
items.q: So my mother got me involved in dance.

ctx.x: And was there was a point where, in talking to your friends, that you discovered that what your mom did was a little different?

Yeah because they’d say, “Oh what do your parents do?” I said, “Well they’re musicians.” And people would say, “Oh, okay.” Because people didn’t think that was a real source of income. That wasn’t real work. So they went to work at night. They didn’t go to work in the daytime like everybody else. And so you know I didn’t really talk about Louis Armstrong for a long time, because people didn’t believe that my father — oh if you say, “Oh I was at Louis Armstrong’s house last night.” “Yeah, sure. Sure you were.” So…
And then you went to a drama academy, also?
